title: Surjective component of sectionwise ring-object reconstruction
statement: Surjective component: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with a Grothendieck topology $J$. Work in any universe of sets at least as large as the object and morphism universes of $\mathcal C$. Let $F$ be a functor from sheaves of commutative rings to internal commutative ring objects of sheaves of sets. Suppose $h_F$ identifies the composite of $F$ with the internal-object forgetful functor with the usual underlying-set sheaf functor, as an equality of functors. Suppose that on every object $A$ and every section set, the transport given by $h_F$ sends each of the five internal operations (addition, zero, negation, multiplication, one) to the corresponding operation on $A$. Then the function on objects of F is surjective.

source.place: Section 00YR (section-sheaves-algebraic-structures), proof of Proposition 00YV (proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi), rings as sextuples

proof.text: Given an internal commutative ring object R, apply the sectionwise reconstruction theorem to obtain a ring sheaf A on the identical underlying sheaf, with equality h and all five operation compatibility equations.

Evaluate hF on A to get equality k between the underlying sheaf of F(A) and that of A. Mathlib eqToHom_app identifies the transport along k with the component of the functor equality hF, so hops A supplies the same operation compatibility equations for F(A).

Eliminate the underlying-sheaf equalities h and k. Sheaf.hom_ext, NatTrans.ext and ConcreteCategory.hom_ext reduce equality of the five operation morphisms to equality on sections; each follows by composing its compatibility equation for F(A) with the reverse equation for R. Eliminating the constructors of CommRingObj, RingObj, AddGrpObj, AddMonObj and MonObj then proves equality of the internal structures by these five equalities and proof irrelevance. Hence F.obj A = R, giving a preimage of every R.

lean.statement:
theorem sheafRingObjects_surjective
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (F : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w} ⥤
      CommRingObjCat (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w))))
    (hF : F ⋙ CommRingObjCat.forget _ =
      sheafCompose J (forget CommRingCat.{max u v w}))
    (hops : ∀ (A : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w}) (U : Cᵒᵖ),
        (∀ a b : (F.obj A).X.obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((AddMonObj.add (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U (a, b)) =
            (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U a) +
              (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U b)) ∧
        (∀ t : (𝟙_ (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w)))).obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((AddMonObj.zero (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U t) =
            (0 : A.obj.obj U)) ∧
        (∀ a : (F.obj A).X.obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((AddGrpObj.neg (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U a) =
            -(show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U a)) ∧
        (∀ a b : (F.obj A).X.obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((MonObj.mul (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U (a, b)) =
            (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U a) *
              (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U b)) ∧
        (∀ t : (𝟙_ (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w)))).obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((MonObj.one (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U t) =
            (1 : A.obj.obj U))) :
    Function.Surjective F.obj
